help.body: First, select the semester. Each row is a "class" (a section of a course); click "Assign / Change" and select the instructor. Each instructor's teaching load (number of classes) is shown next to their name. Classes are created in "Course Offerings / Sectioning"; here you only assign the instructor. With "Teaching Assistant", you can add one or more TAs to the class; the TA gains access to the student roster and class analytics, and can enter grades as drafts, but final grade submission is restricted to the instructor.
